quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas predicts the Knicks will beat the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: The only person that goes into the Garden, that wipes the Garden with his ass cheek is that man.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: If the Wizards and the Knicks play in the playoffs, who you got?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Think about what I'm saying. When you put Trey Young in the Garden, the only person that goes into the Garden, that wipes the Garden with his ass cheek is that man and that man only. He is the kryptonite to the Garden. Now he's coming in with some real boys behind him.

text_blocks.speaker: Rashad McCants
text_blocks.text: I agree. The only thing I'm worried about is outside of Trey Young and him, there's not much experience compared to a championship-proven team.

quotes.speaker: Rashad McCants
quotes.summary_phrase: Rashad McCants calls the current Wizards the most talented ever
quotes.excerpt: I think this is one of the most talented Wizards team in a long time.

text_blocks.speaker: Rashad McCants
text_blocks.text: I think this is one of the most talented Wizards team in a long time. But the matchup of the champ, that's the biggest difference. On paper, yeah, they got a lot of talent.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: They got three number ones, and they got a deep bench. They got a defensive coach.

text_blocks.speaker: Rashad McCants
text_blocks.text: They got a deep bench, but they got a lot of young guys.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert evaluates the Knicks and Wizards playoff potential
quotes.excerpt: I'm in no way saying the Knicks are not better than the Wizards because they are.
quotes.quote: I'm in no way saying the Knicks are not better than the Wizards because they are. What I am saying is Gilbert is right. If that's your first round, that's a doozy. Anthony Davis's first go-round in the playoffs, it's going to be exciting, guaranteed. Trey Young finally feeling like I got a good team, and sometimes they're just going to do miraculous shit and I can take a break. It's going to be night and day. But you forget, he is the biggest lob threat. He is a dribbling Steph Curry. He's got the floater, he can get the lob threat up to whoever his lob threat is. Anthony Davis is going to be a safe target, very safe. And Anthony Davis cuts like a son of a bitch. Jesus Christ, that kid plays hard. They definitely got to stay healthy, but it's just when you look at it and say what's coming in in the playoffs, who can combat Jalen Brunson going off? I think Trey Young can. He's got firepower.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert discusses Karl-Anthony Towns' contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: I don't think there's any comfort to be found, which doesn't sound very positive.
quotes.quote: Actually, Karl-Anthony Towns today in media day, they asked him, is there some comfort with negotiating during a season? Or is he down to wait, or what the deal is? And what he said was, I don't think there's any comfort to be found, which doesn't sound very positive. And then he talked about how he was kind of surprised that they let Mitchell Robinson go. So it doesn't seem like, you know, he's a professional, but it doesn't seem like he's the happiest with how things have been going so far in the off-season.
